Anthropic, PBC develops and maintains advanced artificial intelligence (AI) models in the United States and internationally. The company's Claude Platform lets developers and businesses build, manage, and deploy agentic AI applications on infrastructure. Its direct applications and integrations include Claude Code, a coding agent that handles multi-step software development tasks; Claude Cowork, a work agent that has computer-use capability and enables it to work with professionals on end-to-end business tasks; Claude.ai, a conversational product for enterprises, teams, and individuals; Claude Security, a defensive cybersecurity product; Claude Duet, a proactive agent that monitors connected applications, provide daily briefings, perform tasks, and builds web applications while operating on a cloud-based virtual machine; Claude Tag, a collaborative agent that works alongside teams in productivity tools; Claude Design, which enables users to create polished designs, prototypes, presentations, and other visual work through natural language conversation and direct editing; and Claude Science, an AI workbench for scientific research that brings literature analysis, data processing, and manuscript preparation into a single desktop environment. The company serves financial services, healthcare, life sciences, law, and education industries. Anthropic, PBC was incorporated in 2021 and is based in San Francisco, California.
